findings.title: No driver offers a device of the claimed class
findings.cause: request gpu of ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-shj8d-gpu-49dgv asks for devices of DeviceClass accel.example.com, and no ResourceSlice offers a device from driver accel.example.com, which the class's selectors pick: the driver is not running, or it has found no device on any node, so the scheduler cannot allocate the claim on any node; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.command: kubectl get resourceclaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-shj8d-gpu-49dgv -n kd-dra-no-driver -o jsonpath='{.spec.devices.requests}'

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 cannot allocate all claims. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

findings.fix: Install or start the DRA driver for this class (its kubelet plugin runs as a DaemonSet on the nodes with the devices), and check its pods' logs for why it publishes nothing.
